Steps to run regression tests on a PTF build

Posted on 2021-01-16 | In Test

There are some regression testing on a PTF build, I collected some of them here, which I was doing so far. It is not a full list but limited, just for your reference.

Filesystem Core Regression

Prerequisites

  • An existing GPFS cluster with a PTF build, and have one filesystem mounted.
  • The testing filesystem must be created with 4 disks(NSD), due to some script need at least 3 disks in the system pool. And one step will remove one disk for testing in the middle of the testing.
  • Mount it2n01:/u/gpfstest on all testing nodes, ensure the variable PATH added the path /u/gpfstest/bin too.
  • Define a file /nodes with specific nodes name which will be used, and they should have installed python3. If the OS is AIX, ensure a symbolic link /usr/bin/python3 linked to the real python3 executable file.

Steps to run the regression test

  1. Depend on what kinds of testing what you will run(e.g. gerontion or quota testing), you might add users on all nodes firstly.

    # /u/gpfstest/config/OS/userAdd --numUser 256 -u 94613 -g 100 -p pfs --fvt

    This command will run hours in my testing, can do it on a screen session.

  2. Run the test command, it will call sub-scripts.

    Example:
# nohup /u/gpfstest/bin/regressiontest --no -F fs1 -x --startstress="/u/gpfstest/bin/gerontion -N /nodes -F fs1 --ea --acl --dio --aio --vio --compress ioMixer cacheFiller aclStress" --stopstress="/u/gpfstest/bin/gerontion_killer ioMixer cacheFiller aclStress" >> ~/regressiontest-fs1-15Jan.log &

    Above command run testing against file system fs1 and redirect the output to log file regressiontest-fs1-15Jan.log

mmbackup and HSM Regression

Prerequisites

  • One existing TSM server and one or two TSM clients (HSM node)
  • An existing GPFS cluster with a PTF build, and have one filesystem mounted.
  • The testing filesystem must enable DMAPI function
  • Mount it2n01:/u/gpfstest on all testing nodes
  • You might need two HSM nodes for some test case

Steps to run the regression test

  1. Start DMAPI related service firstly if not yet

    # dsmmigfs start

  2. Enable DMAPI function on the testing filesystem

    # mmumount <filesystem> -a
# mmchfs <filesystem> -z yes        // Enable DMAPI function on the specific file system
# mmmount <filesystem> -a
   
Examples:
# mmumount fs1 -a
# mmchfs fs1 -z yes
# mmmount fs1 -a

  3. Add HSM support for the filesystem firstly

    # dsmmigfs Add /gpfs/fs1

    I hit the error ANS9543W once due to the file system issue, it is ok after re-mounting it.

  4. Run mmbackup regression test

    Example:
# /u/gpfstest/regression/backup_archive/TSM/mmbackupreg.pl -f fs1 -N <worker_node> -l /log/mmbackup -m 2 -v 1,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,10

    The test case2 will be failed always, so bypass here.

  5. Run HSM regression test

    Example:
# /u/gpfstest/regression/backup_archive/TSM/hsmreg.pl -f fs1 -l /log/mmbackup    // Run all cases
# /u/gpfstest/regression/backup_archive/TSM/hsmreg.pl -f fs1 -l /log/mmbackup -v 8 -t 900

    The test case5 need two HSM nodes, and have better to add custom timeout(e.g. -t 900) for the test case8.

Multicluster and Ciperlist rotation Regression

Prerequisites

  • Two existing GPFS clusters with a PTF build
  • The client cluster(clusterB) mount a remote GPFS filesystem of server cluster(clusterA), the I/O will be ran on the mounted file system. You can refer to this article to setup a multicluster environment.
  • Have better not to start filesystem core regression test at the same time, because it might shutdown the NSD node if it is also configured for the remote file system in your environment.

Steps to run the regression test

  1. Run I/O on the mounted remote file system, such as blast or vdbench and so on.

  2. Update a different security level on the server cluster(clusterA) during I/Os running, the existing I/O should not be interrupted.

    # mmauth show ciphers                         // To find a list of supported ciphers
# mmauth update <clusterB> -l AES128-SHA      // Assuming previous security level was AUTHONLY 
# mmauth update <clusterB> -l AES256-SHA256

References

  • The help output of regressiontest

    # /u/gpfstest/bin/regressiontest -h
Command issued was /u/gpfstest/bin/regressiontest -h
  
Great, GPFS is installed. Continuing.
Daemon is at 2305 but cluster is at 2301. Do not run mmchfs -V full
  
Usage: regressiontest -f filesystem [-d firstDisk] [-s secondDisk] [-t thirdDisk|NONE]
    [-n nodeName] [-M] [-x] [-l numberOfLoops] [-p pauseBetweenCommands] [-m pauseForMount]
    [--startstress="scriptToStartStress"] [--stopstress="scriptToKillStress"]
    [--gerontionCommands=commaSeparatedList] [--gerontionFlags="flags"]
    [-w WinDriveLetter] [--nosnapshots] [--nofilesets] [--norecovery] [--noclones]
    [--nosobar] [--tokencheck] [--mmcrfs-undoc] [--snc] [--forcediffblocksizes] [--no]
    [--skipsmallfs] [--runonlysmallfs] [--norestorefs] [--tracescope] [--mmdefragfs] [--longUsage|--help]
    [--bypassfsckprompt] [--4kdisk] [--express] [--skipquotas] [--time] [--skipnetverify]
  
If -d, -s or -t are not specified random disks in the file system will be chosen at the
    beginning of each loop.
If -t NONE is specified then a third disk will not be used (old school regressiontest).
If -n is not specified then a random node in the cluster is chosen at the beginning of each loop.
If --norecovery is specified then recovery type tests will NOT run (ie mmshutdown, mmexpelnode).
If --nosnapshots is specified then snapshot tests will NOT run.
If --norestorefs is specified then mmrestorefs and checksums will be run.
If --noclones is specified then clone related tests will NOT run.
If --nofilesets is specified then fileset tests will NOT run.
If --nosobar is specified then mmimgbackup and mmimgrestore, sobar tests, will NOT run.
If --no is specified then do not prompt after a failure (old school regressiontest).
If --mmcrfs-undoc is specified then some undocumented mmcrfs options will be run in addition.
   These options are -i and --dir-block-size.
If --snc is specified then all the snc flags on mmcrfs will be utilized.
If --skipquotas is provided then we omit quota commands
If --skipsmallfs is used then the creation and munipulation of the small 1 disk file system
   will be skipped. This is useful for testing SNC (and others) since the small file
   has nothing to do with SNC.
If --runonlysmallfs is used then the creation and munipulation of the small 1 disk file system
   will be run and nothing else. This will be done for only one iteration
printlongusage: ./regressiontest[1916]: it's: not found
--forcediffblocksizes is used to run with different data and metadata block sizes in newly
   created small filesystem.
If --tokencheck is specified then each time a return code is checked, gpfs will run a
   diagnostic, tsfsctl fsname --token-check, to make sure tokens are in a good state.
The default for -l is 100. If 0 given then skips down to bottom.
-p is the number of seconds between commands. On a stressed system this should not be
   too low. Default is 25 seconds.
-m is the number of seconds to wait for the mount/unmount commands to finish. Default is 60 seconds.
-w is the Windows drive letter for the temporary file system. Default is G.
--time adds the "time" command to all commands.
-M gathers selected commands on linux to aid in memory leak detection. Find in /log/$date.
-x says to run offline mmfsck after major commands. Either no stress can be running or
   use --startstress and --stopstress.
--startstress is used in concert with --stopstress. It needs to be a command in quotes or a
   file/program that starts stress at the beginning of each loop or after the unmount for mmfsck.
   Be aware that the equal sign (=) is required.
--stopstress is used in concert with --startstress. It needs to be a command in quotes or a
   file/program that kills or stops the stress started with --startstress.
   Be aware that the equal sign (=) is required.
Instead of using startstress/stopstress, you can use the --gerontionCommands and --gerontionFlags
   flags to specify the gerontion commands and flags to use. Note that --startstress and stopstress is
   incompatible with --gerontionCommands and --gerontionFlags
--tracescope is used for the mmdsh mmtrace command. It is the scope of that command. It is
   useful to specify a value so that traces are cut for multicluster problems. The default
   is "all".
--mmdefragfs is used to run mmdefragfs after populateFS to make full block available.
   it is useful for the small file system with a small size of disk.
--bypassfsckprompt is used to pass -xb option to the mmfsck call.
   Useful if you are hitting questions during mmfsck related to the environment setup.
--4kdisk is used to test GPFS 4k-aligned file system
--express is used to test GPFS Express Edition installs.
--noxa is used to ignore the -xa flag. It is on by default.
   All extended features like - ILM, AFM, CNFS tests will be automatically disabled.
  
  
Examples:
1. regressiontest -f fs1
   Runs regressiontest against fs1. Disks and node are chosen randomly at the beginning of
   each loop and runs forever.
  
1a regressiontest -f fs1 --gerontionCommands tortdir,ioMixer --gerontionFlags="--mmap --dio"
   Runs regressiontest against fs1 and handles gerontion IO automatically
  
2. regressiontest -f fs1 -d gpfs1nsd -s gpfs2nsd -n c154n01 --norecovery
   Runs command regression using disks gpfs1nsd and gpfs2nsd and c154n01 in all loops.
   No randomness. No recovery commands will run meaning stress will stay running on c154n01.
  
3. regressiontest -f fs1 -x --startstress="/u/gpfstest/bin/gerontion -N /nodes -F fs1 mkfiles" --stopstress="/u/gpfstest/bin/gerontion_killer mkfiles"
   Runs offline fsck against fs1 after major commands. Runs mkfiles stress which is stopped
   before fsck and started again afterwards.  Since a command string is given for stress,
   the quotes are not optional.
  
4. regressiontest -f fs1 --startstress=/u/steve/bin/startscript --stopstress=/u/steve/bin/stopscript -l 10
   Starts stress using startscript at the start of each of the 10 loops.  Uses stopscript
   to stop and clean up stress at the end of each of the 10 loops.
  
5. regressiontest -f fs1 -l 1 -p 2
   This command is useful for verifying ptfs or builds.  It runs through all the commands
   one time and only pauses 2 seconds between the commands rather than the usual 25
   seconds.  This gives just enough time for the mmsdrfs to be copied around.
  
6. regressiontest -f fs2 | tee /u/steve/tmp/regressiontest.fs2.out 2>&1
   Same as example 1, but pipes output to a file and the screen.  This allows user to still
   be able to hit y or n in case it dies at an ok time.
  
7. nohup regressiontest -f fs3 --no > /u/steve/tmp/regressiontest.fs3.out 2>&1
   Same as example 6, but pipes output to a file.  The --no is required if using nohup.

   --ea            EA stress. For <dbench iago dirsplit driver ioMixer dioReg smallSeq kodak dataInode leveller cantor>
   --acl           ACL stress. For <iago dirsplit aclStress ioMixer driver smallSeq dioReg kodak dataInode thrasher>
   --prealloc      Use gpfs_prealloc. For <driver tribunal iago>
   --percentFallocate: requires --prealloc. For iago only. What percent of the time we should use fallocate vs gpfs_prealloc
   --compress      Use GPFS compression. For <ioMixer dioReg driver tribunal mixedMeterIO truncbane iago dataInode dirsplit smallSeq kodak leveller cantor>
   --normalIO      Programs which default to random IO forms will use normal IO instead. For <kentStress cloneVM mixedMeterIO>
   --all           Enable all flavors of I/O
                   Clones, declones, compression, eas, prealloc, aio, vio, and a 50-50 pick between mmap and dio
   --randomFlags   A random selection of I/O flavors

     NB fstest and blast are the only ones that run on windows nodes
   --randomCmd X  In addition to any named programs, start X randomly chosen programs
   --exclude "P1 P2 ..."  For randomCmd, never use these programs.
  
 Magic Keywords:
   autotest ==> dirstress, kgnrdwr, and tortdir
   light    ==> cdata, locktest, and checkdata. With minimal intensity.
  
Examples:
  gerontion -N /nodes -F fs0 dbench cdata fstest gpfsperf
    Run these programs on the nodes in /nodes into FS fs0
  gerontion -N vmip101,vmip102 -F gpfs1 -f rundir --randomCmd 3 --randomFlags
    Run 3 programs on these 2 nodes into FS gpfs1 subdir rundir. Use random I/O modes.
  gerontion ... -c /tmp/newCommands.pl autotest
    Run the autotest suite using the commands specified in /tmp/newCommands.pl
  gerontion ... -w -F /NFS_mount_point fstest
    Run fstest on non-Windows nodes into this NFS mount point
  gerontion ... --nodeExclude linuxnodes --light ...
    Exclude linux nodes from this light workload
